name: Yeastar P550
verifiedFacts: Supports SIP trunks; analogue interfaces depend on fitted modules.
caveats: Do not describe optional maximum FXS/FXO module capacities as included ports.
Linkus, remote access, hotel/PMS and advanced functions require exact edition, firmware, modules and subscription review.

name: Yeastar TA400
verifiedFacts: Four FXS ports for suitable analogue telephones or fax endpoints.
Connects supported analogue endpoints to a designed IP-PBX installation.
caveats: FXS is the handset-facing interface, not the PSTN-line-facing interface.
Assess wiring condition, port capacity, power and supported provisioning.

name: Yeastar TA410
verifiedFacts: Four FXO ports for analogue external lines.
caveats: Ordinary analogue room phones must not be connected as FXS handsets to FXO ports.
Confirm carrier line signalling and regional configuration; do not imply mobile/SIP trunk service included.

name: Yealink SIP-T31P
verifiedFacts: Two-line desk IP phone with built-in PoE.
T3 specification lists two 10/100 Ethernet ports; Gigabit belongs to T31G.
caveats: External AC adapter is optional; confirm included power accessories and PBX provisioning/firmware.

name: Grandstream GRP2602P
verifiedFacts: PoE-enabled variant of GRP2602 office phone.
Two-line SIP handset; GDMS management supported.
caveats: Official image is GRP2602 family image, not proof of exact suffix or inventory.
Current family page lists four SIP accounts, older documentation differs; avoid account-count promise unless hardware/firmware pinned.
Do not confuse P PoE model with W Wi-Fi or G Gigabit variant.

name: Grandstream GHP610
verifiedFacts: GHP610 wired version has a 100Mbps network port with PoE.
Guest-room speed-dial labelling and wall/desk installation are supported by series.
caveats: Official image shows GHP610/GHP611 family, not an installed customer system.
Wi-Fi is the W variant; PoE listed for GHP610/GHP611 non-W variants.
Hotel PMS functions belong to compatible PBX/software integration, not standalone handset promise.
